title: health/metadata-iosxe.json
description: IOS-XE plane board (Kind metadata). Health Device only. Rewritten every visit, including quiet visits. last_visit_id is the last stamp written; last_collected_at is the last completed collection. current[] is the last-known state of every subject and is what the next visit diffs against. No port, no host, no credentials. RESTCONF port stays on inventory/prod.json.

keys.description: Union of every key on current[] and relations[].

last_visit_id.description: watch_id of the last stamp written. Unchanged on a quiet visit.

last_collected_at.description: checked_at of the last completed collection, stamp or not. Freshness readers use this.

baseline_visit_id.description: watch_id of the first-visit stamp (the one that wrote every subject). Stamps point at it with baseline_ref.

current.description: One row per subject the last collection returned: every admin-up interface, every BGP neighbor, every ACL. Rows for a device that was not collected this visit are kept as they were.

series.description: metrics[] rows of the last 10 visits, oldest first. When a visit is appended and more than 10 visits are present, drop every row of the oldest visit.

relations.description: Every observed edge the last collection saw (CDP/LLDP neighbor -> connected_to; BGP neighbor resolved to an inventory device -> peers_with). Rebuilt each visit.

keys.description: device:<name> plus interface:<device>/<interface> for interface and acl rows; plus the peer device key on a resolved bgp row.

subject.description: Interface name, BGP neighbor id, or ACL name as the device returned it.

last_changed.description: When a material field on this row last changed. Interface rows: the device's last-change when present, else the checked_at of the visit that saw the change. New rows: this visit's checked_at.

rx_kbps.description: interface: last-seen rate. Movement is not material.

input_acl.description: interface: input-security-acl name, null when none.

neighbor.description: interface: CDP/LLDP neighbor as interface:<device>/<port> when the neighbor name resolves to an inventory device; else null.

up_time.description: bgp: up-time as returned. A shorter value than the prior visit is a session reset.

peer.description: bgp: device:<name> when the neighbor address matches an inventory/infra-sot.json interface cidr; else null.

present.description: acl: false when the ACL GET returned 204 for this device (one row per device with subject none).

bound_to.description: acl: interfaces whose input_acl or output_acl names this ACL.

matches_total.description: acl: sum of ACE match counters. Movement after the first hit is not material.

acls.description: ACLs present on the device. 0 when the ACL GET returned 204. null when not collected.

watch_id.description: The stamp id when one was written; null on a quiet visit.

delta.description: Same value as the visit's vs_prior.delta.

evidence_ref.description: The GET path that returned the neighbor, e.g. Cisco-IOS-XE-cdp-oper:cdp-neighbor-details on device:<name>.
